sentence: This project develops methods that lower the radiation dose and shorten the scan time of PET/CT in pediatric patients.
This project builds tools that use deep learning to measure early cerebellum development in infant brain MRI.
This project studies the progression of chronic kidney diseases of uncertain etiology in agricultural communities.
This project studies how human ghrelin protects the intestine from radiation and tests it as a treatment for acute radiation syndrome.
This project studies breast and cervical cancer screening patterns by sexual orientation and simulates the expected burden of cancer.
This project measures the chemically distinct molecules in brain cells that can be modified by exposure to drugs of abuse.
This project studies immune response in the tumor microenvironment to develop immunotherapy strategies for treating cancer.
This project studies a circuit that can provoke myelofibrosis and tests whether targeting it could help patients with the disease.
This project builds technologies that profile proteoforms in single cells from tissue, especially rare cells.
This project builds a gut-on-chip model to test how stretch and shear stress affect neurons and glia of the enteric nervous system.
This project uses a diurnal rodent to study the neural mechanisms behind sleep disturbances in a genetic disorder.
This project studies how a receptor worsens COVID-19 in an aged population prone to vascular dementia, using animal and cell culture models.
This project studies a protein that becomes depleted in aging bone and whether replenishing it restores the function of bone stem cells.
This project tries to find out how HIV blocks the antiviral effect of a protein found at the plasma membrane of cells.
This project improves a free web-based medical imaging viewer that researchers use to visualize and quantify cancer disease in imaging exams.
This project tests whether liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry can guide the rational design of natural product libraries.
This project develops and implements multi-site clinical research studies on cancer control and cancer care delivery to improve the quality of cancer care.
This project uses artificial intelligence to study genetic and tissue features of pancreatic cancer in high-risk patient populations.
This project builds a machine learning model that predicts cardiomyopathy in pediatric cancer survivors using clinical and echocardiographic data.
This project improves imaging technologies that detect tuberculosis infection and track bacterial viability during disease.
